query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as avec_qid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wikidata_qid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sans_qid,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_couverture
FROM traditions_olfactives;
